plugins.description: A discipline layer for Claude Code, not an orchestrator: a terse principal-engineer register, evidence gates on the model's own output, and a stop before it builds the wrong thing. Everything fires on demand: four specialists, six skills, five advisory hooks, and no runtime injection on the tool-call path.
